app_fee.value: The College of Science charges a $100 application fee for PhD applicants (not for master's or certificates).
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $100 | PhD – required

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee waiver is described on the pages checked.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: No minimum score is published on the pages checked; the college refers to individual program requirements.

english_waiver.value: A bachelor's or master's degree taught only in English is exempt, but you must submit documentation proving English was the only language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Students may be exempt from the requirement if they submit documentation proving they received a bachelor’s or master’s degree from a college or university in which English was the only language of instruction.

notes: Northeastern colleges admit separately. Rules here come from the College of Science application page (the Khoury College and College of Engineering sites returned 502 errors, so their fee, GRE and English rules are Not stated).
